editorNotes.whyItWorks: This prompt captures old-money understated elegance by emphasizing bespoke craftsmanship over flashy brand emblems. Tailored navy Italian wool, a brushed platinum timepiece, and warm dusk architectural lighting give the scene credibility and prestige.
editorNotes.variationGuide: Shift the location from a private estate driveway to the interior of a Gulfstream cabin at cruising altitude, or a classic wooden Riva motorboat gliding across Lake Como. Experiment with casual luxury: a cream linen shirt and tailored shorts on a sunlit yacht deck.
editorNotes.failureModes: Generators often invent garbled luxury brand logos on sunglasses or watches. Explicitly specify 'unbranded bespoke menswear, minimalist accessories, and realistic fabric drape without visible logos or monograms'.
editorNotes.exampleTweak: Change location to 'Lake Como terrace villa, relaxed seated pose with linen blazer, espresso cup on stone table, golden afternoon sun on water'.
